system.description:
At 6th level, you’ve begun to undertake quests, but you hold them with a fervor unmatched by other champions. Should you fail a quest by taking a long rest, you can rededicate yourself to the same quest at the end of the long rest. When you do so, you gain the benefits of the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.ODYsXgw5q0mwxp4N]{Questing} feature and ignore a level of strife.

Should you fail, you gain an additional level of strife and are unable to initiate a new quest until you’ve taken a long rest in a safe haven.
